chain-cassette-speeds.message: The chain is not made for the cassette's number of speeds.
chain-cassette-speeds.fix: Buy a chain with the same speed count as the cassette.

chain-freewheel-speeds.message: The chain does not match the freewheel's number of speeds.
chain-freewheel-speeds.fix: A 5- to 8-speed freewheel needs a 6-7-8-speed chain.

derailleur-cassette-speeds.message: The rear derailleur and the cassette have different speed counts.
derailleur-cassette-speeds.fix: Pick a derailleur and a cassette with the same speed count.

shifter-derailleur-speeds.message: The shifter and the rear derailleur have different speed counts.
shifter-derailleur-speeds.fix: The shifter needs exactly as many clicks as the derailleur has speeds.

shifter-hub-speeds.message: The shifter does not match the hub's number of gears.
shifter-hub-speeds.fix: Use the shifter made for this hub, same brand and same gear count.

shifter-derailleur-brand.message: The shifter and the derailleur pull cable differently.
shifter-derailleur-brand.fix: Stay within one brand; up to 10 speeds, microSHIFT and Shimano can be mixed.

shifter-derailleur-actuation.message: A mechanical shifter cannot drive an electronic derailleur, or the other way round.
shifter-derailleur-actuation.fix: Shifter and derailleur must both be mechanical or both electronic.

front-shifter-chainrings.message: The left shifter does not have as many positions as the crankset has chainrings.
front-shifter-chainrings.fix: Use a 2-position left shifter for a double, a 3-position one for a triple.

derailleur-max-cog.message: The largest sprocket is bigger than the rear derailleur can reach.
derailleur-max-cog.fix: Pick a tighter cassette, or a derailleur with a longer cage.

cassette-freehub.message: This cassette does not fit this freehub body.
cassette-freehub.fix: Buy a cassette for the wheel's freehub body, or change the body.

cassette-speeds-freehub.message: This freehub body does not take a cassette with this many speeds.
cassette-speeds-freehub.fix: Check which cassettes the freehub body accepts.

freewheel-body.message: A freewheel threads onto a threaded hub, not onto a cassette body.
freewheel-body.fix: Buy a cassette for this hub, or a wheel with a threaded hub.

hanger-standard.message: This derailleur needs a UDH hanger the frame does not have.
hanger-standard.fix: Check the frame takes a UDH hanger, or pick a conventional derailleur.

caliper-rotor-size.message: The caliper is not positioned for this rotor diameter.
caliper-rotor-size.fix: Change the caliper adapter for this diameter, or buy a rotor of the current size.

rotor-caliper-mount.message: This rotor size is unusual for this caliper mount.
rotor-caliper-mount.fix: Check an adapter exists for this combination before buying.

rotor-frame-max.message: The rear rotor is larger than the frame allows.
rotor-frame-max.fix: Stay at or below the frame maker's maximum rotor size.

rotor-fork-max.message: The front rotor is larger than the fork allows.
rotor-fork-max.fix: Stay at or below the fork maker's maximum rotor size.

rotor-hub-interface.message: This rotor does not bolt to this hub (6-bolt and Centerlock differ).
rotor-hub-interface.fix: Buy a rotor with the hub's mounting, or a Centerlock-to-6-bolt adapter.

caliper-frame-mount.message: This caliper does not fit this brake mount.
caliper-frame-mount.fix: Pick a caliper with the same mount, or the matching adapter.

lever-caliper-actuation.message: A mechanical lever cannot operate a hydraulic caliper, or the other way round.
lever-caliper-actuation.fix: Lever and caliper must both be mechanical or both hydraulic.

lever-pull-ratio.message: The lever does not pull the right amount of cable for this brake.
lever-pull-ratio.fix: A V-brake needs a long-pull lever; a road caliper or cantilever needs a short-pull one.

mech-disc-lever-pull.message: The mechanical disc caliper and the lever have different cable pull.
mech-disc-lever-pull.fix: Buy the road (short pull) or mountain (long pull) version that matches the lever.

wheel-axle-frame.message: The rear wheel's axle does not match the frame's dropouts.
wheel-axle-frame.fix: Buy a wheel with the frame's axle standard, or swap the hub end caps if possible.

wheel-axle-fork.message: The front wheel's axle does not match the fork.
wheel-axle-fork.fix: Buy a wheel with the fork's axle standard, or swap the hub end caps if possible.

tire-diameter-wheel.message: The tyre diameter does not match the rim.
tire-diameter-wheel.fix: The tyre's second ETRTO number (e.g. 622) must match the rim.

tire-rim-width.message: This tyre is too narrow or too wide for the rim's width.
tire-rim-width.fix: Pick a tyre width inside the range recommended for this rim.

tubeless-rim-tire.message: A tubeless setup needs a tubeless-ready rim.
tubeless-rim-tire.fix: Use a tubeless-ready rim, or go back to inner tubes.

tire-frame-clearance.message: The rear tyre is wider than the frame clears.
tire-frame-clearance.fix: Stay below the frame's maximum width, with at least 4 mm of room.

tire-fork-clearance.message: The front tyre is wider than the fork clears.
tire-fork-clearance.fix: Stay below the fork's maximum width, with at least 4 mm of room.

headset-frame.message: The headset does not match the frame's head tube.
headset-frame.fix: Buy a headset for the head tube standard (threaded, straight or tapered).

stem-steerer.message: This stem does not clamp onto this fork steerer.
stem-steerer.fix: A threaded steerer needs a quill stem; a straight or tapered one needs a 1-1/8" stem.

stem-bar-clamp.message: The handlebar diameter does not match the stem clamp.
stem-bar-clamp.fix: Use a bar and stem with the same clamp diameter (31.8 or 35 mm…).

seatpost-frame-diameter.message: The seatpost is too big for the seat tube.
seatpost-frame-diameter.fix: Measure the seat tube's inner diameter and buy a post of that size.

seatpost-frame-shim.message: The seatpost is thinner than the seat tube: it needs a shim.
seatpost-frame-shim.fix: Buy the right post size, or a matching shim.

seat-clamp-frame.message: The seat clamp does not match the seat tube's diameter.
seat-clamp-frame.fix: Measure the outside diameter at the top of the seat tube.

bb-shell-frame.message: This bottom bracket does not fit this frame.
bb-shell-frame.fix: Buy a bottom bracket for the frame's shell standard (BSA, BB86, T47…).

bb-spindle-crank.message: The crank spindle does not match the bottom bracket.
bb-spindle-crank.fix: Bottom bracket and crankset must share a spindle standard (Hollowtech II, DUB, square taper…).

pedal-thread-crank.message: The pedal thread does not match the crank arm.
pedal-thread-crank.fix: Buy pedals with the crank's thread (9/16" almost everywhere).

belt-frame-splitter.message: A belt only fits a frame whose rear triangle opens.
belt-frame-splitter.fix: Check the frame has a belt splitter; otherwise stay with a chain.

e-chain-rated.message: This chain is not built for a motor's torque.
e-chain-rated.fix: Buy a chain marked for e-bikes (E-Bike, EPT…): it will wear more slowly.

e-crank-interface.message: These cranks do not fit this motor's spindle.
e-crank-interface.fix: Buy cranks made for the motor's splines (Bosch, Shimano STEPS, Bafang…).
